result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback position and is more protective in two respects: it limits inspections to once per 12 months, retains 30 days’ notice rather than 15 days, and keeps all inspection costs with HDI. It also preserves the existing business-hours and scope limitations. Adding only the frequency cap is appropriately minimal because the independent-auditor, confidentiality, and no-system-access requirements do not appear in the fallback. The drafting is professional, though the phrase “may ... have the right to inspect” remains slightly redundant and awkward.
